source: Formulas.calcBlowDamage and Formulas.calcBackstabDamage (attacker, target, skill, shld, ss)
note: kind 'blow' = calcBlowDamage, kind 'backstab' = calcBackstabDamage, both for every skill (they only read the skill's power, trait, element). result = damage (double, at least 1). shld 2 returns 1 before any draw. One weapon-random draw (RandomizePhysicalSkillDamage). The crit that FatalBlow / Backstab add around these (calcCrit with the skill, x2) is not part of the function. proximity bonus: behind 1.2, front 1, side 1.1. Every case has 'script' (the unit values u in [0,1) that were consumed) and 'rnd' (every Rnd call in order: method, bound, returned value; get_int bound b returns floor(u*b), get_int_range o,b returns o+floor(u*(b-o+1)), nextGaussian is 2u-1 in the harness). Calls that draw nothing are not recorded. Replay the returned values in order and check method and bound.

geometry.note: The target stands at 'target'. The attacker has heading 0 and z = target z + z_diff, and stands at attacker_xy_by_relation[relation] (found by trying 32 spots 40 units away until the real isInFrontOf / isOnSideOf / isBehind agree). Same spots as the formulas_*.json files.
